name: add_github_actions_ci_go
description: Adds a GitHub Actions CI workflow that builds and tests the Go module
prompts: Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow for this Go project at .github/workflows/ci.yml. It must: trigger on both `push` and `pull_request` events targeting the `main` branch; run on `ubuntu-latest`; check out the repository (e.g. actions/checkout@v4); set up Go (e.g. actions/setup-go@v5 with go-version '1.22'); and run both a build step (e.g. `go build ./...`) and a test step (e.g. `go test ./...`).

test_setup_files.check_ci.py:
import re, sys

with open('.github/workflows/ci.yml', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    text = f.read()
low = text.lower()

checks = [
    ('on:' in low, 'missing a top-level "on:" trigger key'),
    ('push' in low, 'missing a push trigger'),
    ('pull_request' in low, 'missing a pull_request trigger'),
    ('main' in low, 'missing a reference to the main branch'),
    ('jobs:' in low, 'missing a jobs: key'),
    ('runs-on' in low, 'missing runs-on'),
    ('ubuntu' in low, 'missing an ubuntu runner'),
    (re.search(r'actions/checkout@v\d', low) is not None, 'missing an actions/checkout step'),
    (re.search(r'actions/setup-go@v\d', low) is not None, 'missing an actions/setup-go step'),
    (re.search(r'1\.2\d', low) is not None, 'missing a go 1.2x version'),
    (re.search(r'go\s+build', low) is not None, 'missing a go build step'),
    (re.search(r'go\s+test', low) is not None, 'missing a go test step'),
]

failed = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
if failed:
    for m in failed:
        print('FAIL:', m)
    sys.exit(1)
print('PASS')
